idea-plugin.name: Agent Context
idea-plugin.description:
Send the selected file path and line range to the active terminal tab. Select text in the editor of Rider, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, or another IntelliJ Platform IDE and press ⌘' (Command plus apostrophe). The plugin saves the file, then inserts its project-relative path and inclusive line range into the selected Terminal tab, for example src/Foo.cs:44-46.

Requires IDE version 2025.3 or newer with the Terminal plugin enabled and Reworked Terminal selected. If ⌘' is already assigned, choose another shortcut for Add Selected Lines to Agent Context in Settings → Keymap.

Build on macOS

  1. Install Gradle 9.x with brew install gradle and check its version with gradle --version.
  2. Build against an installed IDE. This example uses GoLand in ~/Applications; replace the path with Rider, WebStorm, or PyCharm if needed. The IDE's bundled JDK is used automatically. From the project directory, run IDE_APP="$HOME/Applications/GoLand.app", then JAVA_HOME="$IDE_APP/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" gradle buildPlugin "-PlocalIdePath=$IDE_APP".
  3. Find the archive with ls -lh build/distributions/agent-context-*.zip and install it via Settings → Plugins → gear icon → Install Plugin from Disk.

Plugin ID: dev.agentcontext.

action.text: Add Selected Lines to Agent Context
